raw_segments.text: A carriage belonging to Madame Holikov drove up to the gate.
The captain, who had been expecting the doctor all the morning, rushed headlong out to meet
Mama pulled herself together and assumed a dignified air.
Alyosha went up to Alyosha and began setting his pillows straight.
Nina, from her invalid chair, anxiously watched him putting the bed tidy.
Some of them promised to come again in the evening.
Kalia called Perezven and the dog jumped off the bed.
